# Count the number of unique players (by name) from each college
college_counts = df.groupby('college')['name'].nunique()
# Get the maximum count
max_count = college_counts.max()
# Get colleges with the maximum count
top_colleges = college_counts[college_counts == max_count].index.tolist()
# Check if both usc and clemson are among the colleges with the highest count
answer = ('usc' in top_colleges) and ('clemson' in top_colleges) and (len(top_colleges) == 2)
